projects.title: Life Quest
projects.tagline: An 8-bit daily quest for a better life
projects.description: A retro RPG-style dashboard of 45 lessons across 9 paths, each pairing a short reflection with a small real-world quest. A fair Daily Quest rotation with streaks, path progress, favourites, XP and levels.

projects.title: SkyFall
projects.tagline: An interactive WebGPU Mars hero: helicopters, radar, subsurface ice
projects.description: A cinematic WebGPU hero for a Mars mission concept. Three autonomous helicopters separate during descent and a radar sweep reveals possible subsurface ice; drag Mars, ping its surface, and explore hotspots. A conceptual visualization, not live data.
